decision_cruda.rationale: N522-01 stopped (5-8h vent), LH-06 idle. Activate the highest-grade reserve in Norte, RS-N548-02 (9.7 g/t, 350 t, LH514 at 40.8 t/h). Norte stockpile has room (70/450) and trucks are idle, so no haulage limit. Central is near-full and truck-limited, so RS-C564-03 is worse. Roughly 4.5-5 h of loading at 40.8 t/h gives about 190-200 t, or about 60 oz. No loans: no loader is down and no other gain is available.
